{{SCP|combat|40}} [[combat level]] |currency = [[Zeal Tokens]] |tutorial = Yes |music = [[Soul Wars (music track)|Soul Wars]], [[The Waiting Game]] |map = {{Map|x=2206|y=2900|zoom=0|mapID=-1}} |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} [[File:Soul Wars logo.png|left|150px]] [[File:Soul Wars logo (Minigame Teleport).png|left]] '''Soul Wars''' is a [[members]]-only team [[minigame]], a remake of the original {{RSL|Soul Wars}} released in ''RuneScape 2'' on 10 February 2009. In Soul Wars, two opposing teams compete against each other to gather [[soul fragment]]s and offer them to the [[Soul Obelisk]] in order to weaken, and ultimately defeat, each other's Avatars through combat. Each game lasts up to 15 minutes.
